result_text:
The export now names and looks up the `all_files.zip` entries from the configured aspect names, so renaming `buildAndDeployment` no longer breaks the zip export. The change is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`.

- **What was wrong:** `exportZips()` read `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt` by a hardcoded literal. After the rename that file is `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`, so the read threw. The exception was caught in `exportJson()`, which stopped the zip step, so `all_files.zip` and `git-history.zip` were never written.
- **What I changed:** each of the five entries now goes through a small private helper, `getAspectTextEntry(...)`. It builds the file name with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same call the loose-file writer uses, and reads that file. The order (main, test, generated, build and deployment, other) is unchanged, so the default output is the same.
- **Verification:** `mvn -q -o -pl reports test-compile` succeeds. The reports module has no existing tests for the data exporters, so I did not run an end-to-end export with the renamed aspect. I did not run the tests or the full export, so the renamed-aspect case is checked by reading the code only.

I didn't commit anything.
